initiatives.name: EVERYbody Reads
initiatives.description: Lansing, Michigan bookstore and neighborhood center serving underserved communities. Hosts author events, readings, and fundraisers, and preserves local LGBTQ+ history.

initiatives.name: Peace Education Center
initiatives.description: Greater Lansing, Michigan peace and justice group. Publishes PeaceNotes, runs youth outreach and educational programs, hosts an Alternative Holiday Sale, and awards the Tom Schneider Peacemaker Award.

initiatives.name: Salus Center
initiatives.description: 2SLGBTQIA+ community center in downtown Lansing running peer support groups, youth and family programs, events, and free resource hours.

initiatives.name: Punks With Lunch Lansing
initiatives.description: Punks With Lunch Lansing provides harm reduction services to marginalized or underserved individuals.

initiatives.name: The Rent Is Too Damn High - Lansing
initiatives.description: Organization advocating the government for rent control, public housing, and homeless services.

initiatives.name: Lansing for Palestine
initiatives.description: Lansing for Palestine focuses on community driven organizing to end US complicity in Israeli apartheid, settler colonialism and genocide.
